programme.sub-title: Parks and Gardens: Paradise Created by Humans

programme.title: Razor: Science For a Better Future S1 - "Urban Microbiome"

programme.title: Trains That Changed The World S1 - "Supertrains"
programme.desc: The modern supertrains of Mainland China.

programme.title: Rethink S1 - "Zeno’s paradox and The UV - A Blacklight"
programme.sub-title: Zeno’s paradox and The UV - A Blacklight
programme.desc: In a world where nothing is what it seems, we’ll take a look at magician’s trade secrets, the contradictions of Zeno’s paradox, and the UV - A Blacklight. We’ll take another look at the levitation illusion, and illusionist David Blaine.

programme.title: Rethink S1 - "The Art of Shadowgraphy"
programme.desc: In a world where nothing is what it seems, the lights are off and the spotlight is on the art of shadowgraphy. Next up we’ll explore some card tricks and more optical illusions. Then feature rethinker performer Félicien Treway.

programme.title: Rethink S1 - "Is moving pictures an illusion?"
programme.desc: In a world where nothing is what it seems, take a look at the shades of colour, explore the Body transfer illusion, Liars paradox and video. Is moving pictures an illusion?

programme.title: Rethink S1 - "Is a telescope a time machine?"
programme.sub-title: Is a telescope a time machine?
programme.desc: In a world where nothing is what it seems, we explore tricks using sleight of hand. Play games with a water bottle, take a look at the Dunning Kruger effect and answer the question; Is a telescope a time machine?

programme.title: Rethink S1 - "The Leidenfrost Effect"
programme.desc: In a world where nothing is what it seems, let’s play games with colour changing milk. Learn about chroma keys in video editing and do some mental math gymnastics. We’ll also explore the Leidenfrost effect and take a look at rethinker Linwood G Dunn.

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Wood Stoves, Indigo, Synthesiser"
programme.desc: How do they make wood burning stoves that bring warmth to the bleak Norwegian winter? Plus, how do build the synthesiser that changed music forever?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Morgan Cars, Bamboo Cotton, Toilets"
programme.desc: How do they assemble the reinvented Morgan 3 Wheeler? Plus, how do they protect firefighters' hands from heat, flame and chemical attack?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Wind Turbines, Car Tyres, Mushrooms"
programme.desc: How do they make wind turbines with twice the wingspan of a Boeing? Plus, how do they mould car tyres from the ooze of a tree?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Ammo, Dental Drill, Road Markings"
programme.desc: How do they make the tank piercing super bullet? Plus, how do they forge the infamous torture weapon, the dentist's drill?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Giant Power Station, Smallest Aircraft"
programme.desc: How do they make giant floating power stations that provide power around the world? Plus, how do they fabricate the world's smallest aircraft?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Crayons, Mirrors"
programme.desc: How do they create coloured crayons used by children and artists around the world? Plus, how do artisans and craftsmen create treasured mirrors in India?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Electric Race Cars, Mead"
programme.desc: How do they power the next generation of race cars that run on electricity? Plus, how do they make mead - the favourite drink of the infamous Vikings?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Steam-Powered Boat, Waterwall"
programme.desc: How do they build the famous steam-powered paddleboats that cruise the Mississippi River? How did they create the powerful defence system called 'the waterwall'?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Paving Stones, Tuxedo"
programme.desc: How do they make modern paving stones and how has the process changed over thousands of years? Plus, how do they create a traditionally tailored tuxedo suit?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Fire Gloves, Enamel"
programme.desc: How do they fabricate fire gloves for emergency services personnel? Plus, how do they create the enamel that is used in bake-wear around the world?

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Striker II, Navy Drones, F35B Fighter"
programme.sub-title: Striker II, Navy Drones, F35B Fighter
programme.desc: We have rare acces to BAE Systems. At their research centre in Kent, they're developing the futuristic Striker II helmet giving fighter pilots the edge in aerial combat

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Live Fire Exercises, Body Armor, Armored Vehicle AJAX"
programme.sub-title: Live Fire Exercises, Body Armor, Armored Vehicle AJAX
programme.desc: Discover the latest innovations in kit and equipment at the key military and security exhibition in the UK; Lockheed Martin's heat-seeking Indago drone; and the tech spec on the British Army's new armored vehicle, the AJAX.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Battlefield 3-D, Drone Tech, 2-man Orcasub"
programme.desc: The innovative combination of 3D video and drone technology gives infantry soldiers an accurate battlefield picture. Northrop Grumman's top European executive shares their predictions on how technology will change the way we fight.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "USS Zumwalt, Tank Training, Special Forces Vehicle"
programme.sub-title: USS Zumwalt, Tank Training, Special Forces Vehicle
programme.desc: We reveal eye-witness intelligence on the USS Zumwalt, America's ultra-hi tech, four billion dollar guided missile destroyer. Learn more about the British firm who've developed Minerva, an ingenious, low-cost but realistic tank simulator.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Typhoon Fighter, Combat Medics, USS Dwight D. Eisenhower"
programme.sub-title: Typhoon Fighter, Combat Medics, USS Dwight D. Eisenhower
programme.desc: The Military Tech Show captures the moment when BAE System's radical new pilot helmet, the Striker II, goes operational for the first time in a Typhoon fighter aircraft; how interactive technology is helping train military combat medics.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Spear 3 Missile, Battlefield VR, Spy Drones"
programme.sub-title: Spear 3 Missile, Battlefield VR, Spy Drones
programme.desc: European manufacturer MBDA give a hands-on demonstration of their state-of-the-art missile, the Spear 3. Learn how scientists are using a virtual reality headset to see the battlefield in a revealing new way.

programme.title: Air Wars S1 - "Bomber Offensive: Target Germany"
programme.desc: This review examines the effects of Allied bombing raids on German industry, air defense, and morale during the European skies conflict, including the US's development of long-range fighters.

programme.title: Air Wars S1 - "Kamikaze: The Divine Wind"
programme.desc: Witnesses recall the chaos caused by Japan's WWII kamikaze fliers who crashed their planes into American ships as a last-ditch attempt to repel U.S. forces.

programme.title: Air Wars S1 - "Ruling the Waves: Battle of the Atlantic"
programme.sub-title: Ruling the Waves: Battle of the Atlantic
programme.desc: The use of computer graphics and combat footage highlights the significant role of Allied aircraft in neutralizing Nazi Germany's Atlantic naval power, including the destruction of the Bismark.

programme.title: Air Wars S1 - "The Doolittle Raid: 18 April 1942"
programme.desc: Operation Shangri-la, a 1942 bombing raid on Tokyo by Lt. Col. James Doolittle's 16 Mitchell B-25s, was a significant American morale booster following Allied Pacific disasters, though its military significance was minimal.

programme.title: Air Wars S1 - "The Eastern Front 1941-45"
programme.desc: The text addresses the conflict between Hitler's Luftwaffe and the Soviet Air Force, highlighting that despite initial outclassing, Stalin's pilots eventually achieved parity with Allied assistance.

programme.title: Air Wars S1 - "The Great Marianas Turkey Shoot"
programme.desc: The Great Marianas Turkey Shoot was an aerial battle in the Western Pacific where the U.S. successfully shot down over 300 Japanese aircraft with a 12-1 kill-to-loss ratio.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Helmet, a Zippo, a Fuel Bladder, and a Simulated IED"
programme.sub-title: A Helmet, a Zippo, a Fuel Bladder, and a Simulated IED
programme.desc: When a series of delicate snowflake shaped sheets of Aramid are pressed together, they’ll form a piece of headgear that’s comfortable enough to wear to war, and tough enough to take a bullet.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Pistol, a Firetruck, a Ghillie Suit, and an Armored Fighting Vehicle"
programme.sub-title: A Pistol, a Firetruck, a Ghillie Suit, and an Armored Fighting Vehicle
programme.desc: At the Cabot factory in Pennsylvania, USA, a block of steel will be transformed by innovation and artistry into the ultimate update of an American classic. The 1911 did tours of duty in both world wars and Vietnam, and is still prized today by collectors and enthusiasts.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Cannon, a Parachute, a Medal, and a Stretcher"
programme.sub-title: A Cannon, a Parachute, a Medal, and a Stretcher
programme.desc: A battle tank is only as effective as its gun, and for the Stryker vehicle, that’s the M68 105mm cannon. A tube of forged steel will be hammered into the one of the most powerful and famous cannons in modern warfare.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Grenade Launcher, a Flight Simulator, and Ration Packs"
programme.sub-title: A Grenade Launcher, a Flight Simulator, and Ration Packs
programme.desc: The M203 Grenade Launcher is a single shot launcher designed to attach under a rifle barrel. Using the latest technology, bits of plastic and a block of aluminum will be melted, molded, and cut to create a snap-on weapon that increases the firepower in a soldier’s hands by a long shot.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "Jaws of Life, a Tank, and a Watch"
programme.sub-title: Jaws of Life, a Tank, and a Watch
programme.desc: A series of handcrafted, precision-cut pieces will come together to create a first response tool capable of chewing through metal like a can opener. At the scene of an accident, a natural disaster, or in the combat zone, the Jaws of Life can cut through just about anything .
